calculation.description: Raw 20-day return skewness. Positively-skewed assets (right-tail up-moves) outperform over 10d; positive IC in all three regimes (0.109/0.071/0.175 ICIR).

validation.regime_notes: Validated on the 15-asset cross-asset universe; 980 IC dates with >=8 valid instruments. Regime ICs: {"2020-2022": 0.0338, "2023-2024": 0.0223, "2025-2026": 0.0616}. Max abs IC correlation with decodable library factors: 0.6223 (vs skew_vol_comp_20).
